answer: By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The copper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the basalt is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
